yāti.p: [Yā+a+ti] (kri) CL=7 [Yāgatipāpuṇesu. Nīti, dhātu. 137. Yāti-saṃjai-prā.] (1) Come or go ( of holy or respectable persons). (2) Fly. (3) Come close to. (3) Always follow. (5) Accompany. (6) It causes (or) It happens. (7) (A) Cessation. (B) Go away. (C) It is going towards (death). (9) Approach (or) Come near. (10) (A) Take refuge in. (B) Know, Acknowledge.(11) run to somewhere. (12) Follow in. (13) Go back. (14) Escape from (sin). (15) Believe. See original.

yatindriya.p: [Yata+ndriya] (ti) CL=7 (1) One who is control of the six senses. (A) One who is guarded (or) controlled speech (or) action. (B) One who is control of the six senses (such as eyes). (2) have Vīriyindre (meditation).
